HERO.TITLE: Traditional Tarhana — Now Crafted in Sweden
HERO.SUBTITLE: A nourishing, probiotic-rich meal made with organic Swedish ingredients. Ready in minutes, loved for generations.

WHAT_IS.TITLE: What is Tarhana?
WHAT_IS.DESCRIPTION: Tarhana is a fermented blend of yogurt, whole grains and vegetables, dried and crushed into a nourishing soup base. Just add water, simmer for a few minutes, and enjoy a naturally probiotic, savory meal.
WHAT_IS.TRADITIONAL_DESC: Fermented for 21 days to develop natural tanginess and depth of flavor.
WHAT_IS.CLEAN_DESC: Made with organic Swedish grains and real yogurt. No additives, no preservatives.
WHAT_IS.READY_DESC: A warm, nourishing meal in just 5–10 minutes.

PREPARE.TITLE: How to Prepare
PREPARE.STEP1: 1. Add 2 tablespoons of tarhana to 250ml water
PREPARE.STEP3: 3. Add olive oil or toppings if desired
PREPARE.TIP: "Also delicious with vegetable broth or plant-based yogurt."

TASTE.TITLE: What does it taste like?
TASTE.DESCRIPTION: Mildly tangy, savory and comforting. Similar to sourdough depth, with a creamy texture when cooked.

VERSATILITY.TITLE: Not only soup!
VERSATILITY.DESCRIPTION: Tarhana is an incredibly versatile pantry staple. From traditional bowls to modern kitchen hacks, discover how to use it in your daily cooking.
VERSATILITY.SOUP_DESC: The classic, comforting bowl of warmth.
VERSATILITY.THICKENER_DESC: Add body and umami to stews and sauces.
VERSATILITY.BOWLS_DESC: Elevate grain bowls with a savory sprinkle.
VERSATILITY.QUICK_DESC: A nourishing, probiotic meal in minutes.

PRODUCTS.TITLE: Our Products
PRODUCTS.SUBTITLE: Choose your favorite blend and start your tarhana journey today.

RECIPES.TITLE: Classic Tarhana Soup with a Swedish Twist
RECIPES.DESCRIPTION: A comforting blend of traditional Anatolian fermentation and Scandinavian purity. Enhanced with locally sourced Swedish root vegetables and organic cream, this recipe redefines the classic breakfast staple into a gourmet dinner experience.
RECIPES.PASTA_DESC: A thick, protein-rich alternative to traditional marinara. Perfect for a quick weeknight dinner with a probiotic kick.
RECIPES.CRACKERS_DESC: Crispy, sourdough-style crackers made from dehydrated Tarhana base. Pairs beautifully with Nordic cheeses.
RECIPES.DIP_DESC: A zesty, umami-packed dip that brings life to any vegetable platter. High in protein and naturally fermented.
RECIPES.CRUMBLE_DESC: Swap your croutons for nutrient-dense Tarhana crumbles. Pan-fried in butter for an extra golden crunch.

STORY.HERO_TITLE: From My Grandmother’s Kitchen to Modern Swedish Homes
STORY.HERO_SUBTITLE: A centuries-old tradition, rediscovered through motherhood and reimagined for today’s conscious lifestyle.
STORY.PERSONAL_P1: I grew up watching my grandmother prepare tarhana with patience and care. It wasn’t just soup — it was a ritual. Yogurt, grains and vegetables slowly fermented, then dried under the sun to nourish our family throughout the year.
STORY.PERSONAL_P2: It was simple food. Honest food. The kind that warms you from the inside out.
STORY.MOTHERHOOD_P1: Years later, when my daughter began her journey with solid foods, I found myself returning to tarhana.
STORY.MOTHERHOOD_P2: During short trips or busy weeks, all I needed was this simple powder in my bag. Just water, a few minutes of simmering — and I had a warm, nourishing meal I could truly trust.
STORY.MOTHERHOOD_P3: It felt different from ready-made alternatives. It was real. Balanced. Made from ingredients I understood.
STORY.BRIDGING_TITLE: Bridging Tradition and Modern Nordic Life
STORY.BRIDGING_P1: Living in Sweden, I realized that tarhana fits naturally into the Nordic way of eating: clean ingredients, slow processes, and respect for simplicity.
STORY.BRIDGING_P2: Modern Tarhana was born from this connection — bringing ancient fermentation wisdom into modern Swedish kitchens.
STORY.VALUE1_DESC: We believe nourishment takes time. Our tarhana is fermented for 21 days — never rushed.
STORY.VALUE2_DESC: Organic Swedish grains. Real yogurt. No preservatives. Nothing unnecessary.
STORY.VALUE3_DESC: Gentle, comforting and suitable for all ages — from toddlers to grandparents.
STORY.VALUE4_DESC: Easy to carry. Easy to prepare. Easy to trust.
STORY.MORE_P1: Whether you're a busy parent, an active professional, or simply someone who values natural food, tarhana offers something rare — comfort and function in one bowl.
STORY.MORE_P2: A fermented, plant-based protein source that supports a balanced lifestyle without sacrificing taste.
STORY.CLOSING: "For us, tarhana is not just food. It is memory, care, and simplicity — shared around the table."

HEALTH_PAGE.TITLE: Health & Nutrition
HEALTH_PAGE.SUBTITLE: The power of fermentation for your modern lifestyle.
HEALTH_PAGE.PROBIOTICS_DESC: Our 21-day fermentation process creates a rich environment for beneficial bacteria, supporting gut health and your immune system.
HEALTH_PAGE.PROTEIN_DESC: With 18g of plant-based protein per serving, Modern Tarhana is an excellent fuel for an active lifestyle.
HEALTH_PAGE.CLEAN_DESC: No preservatives, no additives, no artificial flavors. Just organic ingredients and the magic of fermentation.
HEALTH_PAGE.SLOW_DESC: We don't rush perfection. Each batch is fermented for exactly 21 days in Swedish organic barns to ensure maximum nutrient density.
